desc.en: Custom corporate website developed for a real client in the architecture and design industry. The project presents premium solutions for windows, doors, kitchens and home elevators through an elegant visual experience inspired by luxury brands, with a focus on refined layouts, product presentation and responsive performance.

Presenta soluciones premium de ventanas, puertas, cocinas y ascensores residenciales con una experiencia visual elegante inspirada en marcas de lujo, enfocada en layouts refinados, presentación de productos y rendimiento responsive.

summary.en: Custom corporate website developed for a real client in the architecture and design industry.

en: Full custom front-end development from design system to production
Responsive layouts for product showcase and collections
Elegant typography and visual hierarchy inspired by luxury brands
Performance-oriented image handling and smooth interactions
SEO-friendly structure and clean semantic HTML

Layouts responsive para showcase de productos y colecciones

longDesc.en: The site focuses on product storytelling: window systems, collections and a clear path to request a quote. Layouts prioritize large photography, restrained typography and smooth section transitions so the brand feels closer to luxury architecture than to a generic contractor brochure. The front-end is fully custom (no page builder), with responsive behaviour tuned for desktop showrooms and mobile browsing.
longDesc.es: El sitio se centra en el storytelling de producto: sistemas de ventanas, colecciones y un camino claro para pedir cotización. Los layouts priorizan fotografía grande, tipografía contenida y transiciones suaves para que la marca se sienta más cercana a arquitectura de lujo que a un brochure genérico. El front-end es 100% a medida (sin page builder), con comportamiento responsive pensado para escritorio y mobile.
